snippet.title: Blue Swirl - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The underwater endless swimmer. Download Blue Swirl now!
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rikzu.blue.swirl
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/blue-swirl/id1513764543

Blue Swirl is a refreshing take on the endless runner genre, it will test your ability to react fast to many obstacles. The deeper you go, the harder it'll get. You'll have to avoid sharks, randomly placed rocks, and even gigantic starfishes.

Website: https://www.rikzugames.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rikzugames/
Discord: https://discord.gg/jBawCAe
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rikzugames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rikzugames/
